newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends year higher on export data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends year higher on export data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Supportive export data for December helped prices to recoup earlier losses on the last trading session of 1996. Trading was sluggish with most participants out of the market for the year-end holidays. March futures' resistance is seen at 1,250 ringgit and support at 1,235.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Moved in line with futures, recovering slightly after easing earlier on lower Chicago soyoil futures.

Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for December at 717,197 tonnes against 700,566 tonnes in November. Caleb Brett put exports at 702,082 tonnes against its estimate of 673,905 for November.
Traders said the underlying sentiment remained steady due to firm fundamentals. Traders have estimated output in December to fall by up to 18 percent from November.
March futures closed nine ringgit higher at 1,255 ringgit ($496.64) a tonne after trading between 1,239 and 1,255.
Traders said the next resistance will be 1,255 ringgit with strong support at 1,235 level.
Among physical, Jan (south) saw offers at 1,290 ringgit against bids at 1,280, after trading from 1,270 to 1,280.
Jan (north) was offered at 1,275 and bids at 1,265. Feb (south) saw offers at 1,290 with bids at 1,280, and Feb (central) was offered at 1,275 and bids at 1,265.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $540 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Feb/Mar at $537.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $535.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $575, Feb/Mar at $570 and Apr/May/June at $562.50.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $410 and Feb/Mar at $415. Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
